title: Congressional Budget Office Data Access Act
official_summary:
Congressional Budget Office Data Access Act

This act exempts the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) from the Privacy Act of 1974 to expedite the sharing of data and information between CBO and federal agencies.

Under current law, the Privacy Act of 1974 generally prohibits federal agencies from disclosing certain records pertaining to an individual without the individual's prior written consent. This act allows federal agencies to disclose such records to CBO (or to an authorized representative of CBO) without obtaining the prior written consent of the individual.

Several agencies, including the Government Accountability Office and the National Archives and Records Administration, are currently exempt from these requirements, and this act adds CBO to the list of exemptions.

summary.headline: New law lets federal agencies share personal records with the Congressional Budget Office without first getting each person's written consent.
summary.what_it_does: The Privacy Act of 1974 generally bars federal agencies from sharing certain records about a person unless that person agrees in writing. This law adds the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) to the list of exceptions, so agencies can share these records with CBO or its authorized representatives without that consent. The goal is to speed up data sharing between CBO and federal agencies. Other offices, such as the Government Accountability Office and the National Archives, already have this exception.

who_it_affects.group: People whose personal information is held in federal agency records
who_it_affects.how: Their records covered by the Privacy Act can now be shared with CBO without their prior written consent.
CBO can get records about individuals from federal agencies more quickly, without needing each person's written consent.
Agencies may now give CBO records about individuals without first getting those people's written consent.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 2, 2024; the summary does not give a separate start date.
